entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: label_join expects at least 3 arguments (v, dst, separator[, src…]), got %d
entries.rationale: Parser-enforced arity: label_join requires at least the vector, destination label, and separator arguments. lowerLabelJoin and labelJoinAttributes pass the same parsed Call to labelJoinAttributesBuilder; lowerLabelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp is reached only after labelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp independently checks the same minimum arity.
